SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.title: Merchant Loans
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.ask_body: You are {Missing} gold short. Ask the other players for help?
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.rules: Gold you earn repays loans. Death does not erase debts. After accepting an offer, try the purchase again.
SLAY_SPOON_LOANS.held: Your offer: {Amount} gold held until accepted or withdrawn.
SPOON_SAPPHIRE_KEY_TIP: Take the Sapphire Key instead of a relic. The key counts for the whole team.
SPOON_SAPPHIRE_KEY_WAIT_TIP: Any player who has not yet chosen may take the Sapphire Key instead of a relic. It counts for the whole team.
SPOON_CHEST_REMATCH_KEY: Rematch: take another relic or the Sapphire Key
SPOON_CHEST_REMATCH_WAIT: Rematch: the other players are choosing again
